tool_schemas.name: GetProgram
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves an ABAP program by name from the specified ADT system and returns its program metadata; when include_source is true, the response also includes the current program source code in the requested language/ABAP language version (or the system defaults). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if system_id does not match the required format or name is empty, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to access the target system or repository object, and NOT_FOUND if the program does not exist in that system. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the SAP ADT backend rejects the request or is unavailable; use_cache may return a previously retrieved artifact only when it is still current, otherwise a fresh retrieval is performed.

system_id.description: Target ADT system id to route the request to.

include_source.description: Whether to retrieve and return the program source code.

language.description: Logon language for ADT retrieval (defaults to system default_language).

abap_language_version.description: ABAP language version context (defaults to system default_abap_language_version).

use_cache.description: Whether to allow returning a previously retrieved artifact if still current.

tool_schemas.name: GetClass
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves an ABAP class by name from the specified ADT system and returns class metadata; when include_source is true, the response also includes the class source in the requested language/ABAP language version (or the system defaults). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid system_id or empty name, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if access to the system or class is not allowed, and NOT_FOUND if the class does not exist. Raises RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the SAP ADT backend returns an error or cannot be reached; if use_cache is enabled, cached content is returned only if still current.

system_id.description: Target ADT system id to route the request to.

include_source.description: Whether to retrieve and return the class source code.

language.description: Logon language for ADT retrieval (defaults to system default_language).

abap_language_version.description: ABAP language version context (defaults to system default_abap_language_version).

use_cache.description: Whether to allow returning a previously retrieved artifact if still current.

tool_schemas.name: GetFunctionGroup
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves an ABAP function group by name from the specified ADT system and returns function-group metadata; when include_source is true, the response also includes the function group’s source where supported by ADT for the requested language/ABAP language version (or system defaults). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid system_id or empty name, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to access the system or the function group, and NOT_FOUND if the function group does not exist. Raises RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the SAP ADT backend fails the request or is unavailable; use_cache may return a current cached artifact, otherwise the function group is fetched again.

system_id.description: Target ADT system id to route the request to.

include_source.description: Whether to retrieve and return the function group source code.

language.description: Logon language for ADT retrieval (defaults to system default_language).

abap_language_version.description: ABAP language version context (defaults to system default_abap_language_version).

use_cache.description: Whether to allow returning a previously retrieved artifact if still current.

tool_schemas.name: GetFunction
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves an ABAP function module by name from the specified ADT system and returns its metadata; when include_source is true, the response also includes the function module source, and function_group may be provided to disambiguate and resolve the correct ADT resource. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid system_id, empty name, or an invalid function_group value, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to access the system or function module, and NOT_FOUND if the function module cannot be resolved or does not exist (including when the provided function_group does not contain it). Raises RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the SAP ADT backend rejects the request or is unavailable; use_cache returns cached content only when still current.

system_id.description: Target ADT system id to route the request to.

function_group.description: Optional owning function group name to disambiguate and resolve ADT URI.

include_source.description: Whether to retrieve and return the function module source code.

language.description: Logon language for ADT retrieval (defaults to system default_language).

abap_language_version.description: ABAP language version context (defaults to system default_abap_language_version).

use_cache.description: Whether to allow returning a previously retrieved artifact if still current.

tool_schemas.name: GetStructure
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a DDIC structure definition by name from the specified ADT system and returns structure metadata; when include_schema is true, the response includes the field list/schema in the requested language (or the system default). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid system_id or empty name, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to access the system or DDIC object, and NOT_FOUND if the structure does not exist. Raises RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the SAP ADT backend returns an error or is unavailable; use_cache is honored only when the cached artifact is still current.

system_id.description: Target ADT system id to route the request to.

include_schema.description: Whether to retrieve and return the DDIC schema/field list.

language.description: Logon language for ADT retrieval (defaults to system default_language).

use_cache.description: Whether to allow returning a previously retrieved artifact if still current.

tool_schemas.name: GetTable
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a DDIC table definition by name from the specified ADT system and returns table metadata; when include_schema is true, the response includes the table’s field list/schema in the requested language (or the system default). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid system_id or empty name, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to access the system or table definition, and NOT_FOUND if the table does not exist. Raises RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the SAP ADT backend rejects the request or is unavailable; use_cache may return a current cached artifact, otherwise the table definition is fetched again.

system_id.description: Target ADT system id to route the request to.

include_schema.description: Whether to retrieve and return the DDIC schema/field list.

language.description: Logon language for ADT retrieval (defaults to system default_language).

use_cache.description: Whether to allow returning a previously retrieved artifact if still current.

tool_schemas.name: GetTableContents
tool_schemas.description: Reads rows from an ABAP table in the specified ADT system and returns a row set with optional field projection (fields), server-side filtering (where), ordering (order_by), and offset/limit pagination; limit is capped by the system table_read_row_limit. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid system_id, empty table name, invalid limit/offset, or invalid fields/where/order_by expressions as accepted by the backend, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to read the table’s contents, and NOT_FOUND if the table does not exist. Raises RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the SAP backend rejects the query or is unavailable; use_cache returns cached results only when still current for the same request parameters.

system_id.description: Target ADT system id to route the request to.

name.description: DDIC table name whose contents should be read.

fields.description: Optional list of field names to return (omit for all fields).

where.description: Optional server-side filter expression for the table read.

order_by.description: Optional sort specification for returned rows (e.g., FIELD1 ASC, FIELD2 DESC).

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (capped by system table_read_row_limit).

offset.description: Number of rows to skip before returning results.

use_cache.description: Whether to allow returning a previously retrieved table-contents artifact if still current.

tool_schemas.name: GetPackage
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves an ABAP package by name from the specified ADT system and returns package metadata; when include_details is true, additional package details are returned in the requested language (or the system default). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid system_id or empty name, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to access the system or package, and NOT_FOUND if the package does not exist. Raises RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the SAP ADT backend returns an error or is unavailable; use_cache is used only when the cached artifact is still current.

system_id.description: Target ADT system id to route the request to.

include_details.description: Whether to retrieve and return package metadata/details.

language.description: Logon language for ADT retrieval (defaults to system default_language).

use_cache.description: Whether to allow returning a previously retrieved artifact if still current.

tool_schemas.name: GetTypeInfo
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves ABAP type information for the provided type_name from the specified ADT system and returns the resolved type description in the requested language/ABAP language version (or the system defaults). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid system_id or empty type_name, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to access the system or type, and NOT_FOUND if the type cannot be resolved in that system. Raises RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded and UPSTREAM_ERROR when the SAP ADT backend rejects the request or is unavailable.

system_id.description: Target ADT system id to route the request to.

type_name.description: ABAP type name to retrieve type information for (e.g., DDIC type/structure/table type/class type).

language.description: Logon language for retrieval (overrides the system default_language if provided).

abap_language_version.description: ABAP language version to use for retrieval (overrides the system default_abap_language_version if provided).

tool_schemas.implementation:
def GetTypeInfo(system_id, type_name, language=None, abap_language_version=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, uuid
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0303000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0303000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0)
    now_iso = now.isoformat() + "Z"

    # Validate
    if not isinstance(system_id, str) or not re.match(r"^adt_sys_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", system_id or ""):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid system_id.")
    if not isinstance(type_name, str) or len(type_name) < 1:
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "type_name must be a non-empty string.")
    if language is not None and (not isinstance(language, str) or len(language) < 1):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "language must be a non-empty string when provided.")
    if abap_language_version is not None and (not isinstance(abap_language_version, str) or len(abap_language_version) < 1):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "abap_language_version must be a non-empty string when provided.")

    systems = _load("adt_systems.json")
    keys = _load("api_keys.json")
    objs = _load("abap_objects.json")
    arts = _load("abap_object_artifacts.json")
    reqs = _load("tool_requests.json")

    sys_row = next((s for s in systems if s.get("id") == system_id and s.get("status") == "active"), None)
    if not sys_row:
        # No request row because no authenticated/eligible context can be resolved for this system
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "ADT system not found or not active.", system_id=system_id)

    # Resolve an authenticated api key that can serve the call (ambient auth)
    def _parse_dt(x):
        if not x:
            return None
        try:
            if isinstance(x, str) and x.endswith("Z"):
                x = x[:-1]
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(x)
        except Exception:
            return None

    eligible_keys = []
    for k in keys:
        if k.get("system_id") != system_id:
            continue
        if k.get("status") != "active":
            continue
        exp = _parse_dt(k.get("expires_at"))
        if exp is not None and not (exp > now):
            continue
        allowed = k.get("allowed_tools")
        if isinstance(allowed, list) and len(allowed) > 0 and "GetTypeInfo" not in allowed:
            continue
        eligible_keys.append(k)

    if not eligible_keys:
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No active API key available for this system/tool.")

    api_key = sorted(eligible_keys, key=lambda r: (r.get("last_used_at") is None, r.get("updated_at") or ""))[0]

    # Create tool_requests row with status=received BEFORE any upstream work (simulated)
    req_id = "req_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
    req_row = {
        "id": req_id,
        "api_key_id": api_key["id"],
        "system_id": system_id,
        "tool_name": "GetTypeInfo",
        "request_params": {  # non-sensitive only
            "type_name": type_name,
            **({"language": language} if language is not None else {}),
            **({"abap_language_version": abap_language_version} if abap_language_version is not None else {}),
        },
        "resolved_object_id": None,
        "http_status": None,
        "duration_ms": 0,
        "error_code": None,
        "error_message": None,
        "result_artifact_id": None,
        "status": "received",
        "requested_at": now_iso,
        "completed_at": None,
        "created_at": now_iso,
        "updated_at": now_iso,
    }
    reqs.append(req_row)
    _save("tool_requests.json", reqs)

    # Enforce key status/expiry (must be recorded as rejected)
    exp = _parse_dt(api_key.get("expires_at"))
    if api_key.get("status") != "active":
        # received -> rejected allowed
        req_row["status"] = "rejected"
        req_row["error_code"] = "KEY_REVOKED"
        req_row["error_message"] = "API key is not active."
        req_row["completed_at"] = now_iso
        req_row["updated_at"] = now_iso
        req_row["duration_ms"] = max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000))
        api_key["last_used_at"] = now_iso
        api_key["updated_at"] = now_iso
        _save("api_keys.json", keys)
        _save("tool_requests.json", reqs)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "API key revoked.", request_id=req_id)
    if exp is not None and not (exp > now):
        req_row["status"] = "rejected"
        req_row["error_code"] = "KEY_EXPIRED"
        req_row["error_message"] = "API key is expired."
        req_row["completed_at"] = now_iso
        req_row["updated_at"] = now_iso
        req_row["duration_ms"] = max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000))
        api_key["last_used_at"] = now_iso
        api_key["updated_at"] = now_iso
        _save("api_keys.json", keys)
        _save("tool_requests.json", reqs)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "API key expired.", request_id=req_id)

    # Enforce system mismatch
    if api_key.get("system_id") != system_id:
        req_row["status"] = "rejected"
        req_row["error_code"] = "SYSTEM_MISMATCH"
        req_row["error_message"] = "API key is not permitted for the requested system."
        req_row["completed_at"] = now_iso
        req_row["updated_at"] = now_iso
        req_row["duration_ms"] = max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000))
        api_key["last_used_at"] = now_iso
        api_key["updated_at"] = now_iso
        _save("api_keys.json", keys)
        _save("tool_requests.json", reqs)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "System mismatch.", request_id=req_id)

    # Rate limit and daily quota
    rpm = api_key.get("requests_per_minute_limit")
    rpd = api_key.get("requests_per_day_limit")
    if not isinstance(rpm, int) or rpm < 0 or not isinstance(rpd, int) or rpd < 0:
        req_row["status"] = "failed"
        req_row["error_code"] = "VALIDATION_ERROR"
        req_row["error_message"] = "Server key limits misconfigured."
        req_row["completed_at"] = now_iso
        req_row["updated_at"] = now_iso
        req_row["duration_ms"] = max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000))
        api_key["last_used_at"] = now_iso
        api_key["updated_at"] = now_iso
        _save("api_keys.json", keys)
        _save("tool_requests.json", reqs)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Key limits misconfigured.", request_id=req_id)

    window_start = now - datetime.timedelta(seconds=60)
    day_start = now.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
    def _req_dt(r):
        return _parse_dt(r.get("requested_at"))
    recent = 0
    daily = 0
    for r in reqs:
        if r.get("api_key_id") != api_key["id"]:
            continue
        rd = _req_dt(r)
        if rd is None:
            continue
        if rd >= window_start:
            recent += 1
        if rd >= day_start:
            daily += 1
    if (rpm >= 0 and recent > rpm) or (rpd >= 0 and daily > rpd):
        req_row["status"] = "rejected"
        req_row["error_code"] = "RATE_LIMITED"
        req_row["error_message"] = "Rate limit or daily quota exceeded."
        req_row["completed_at"] = now_iso
        req_row["updated_at"] = now_iso
        req_row["duration_ms"] = max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000))
        api_key["last_used_at"] = now_iso
        api_key["updated_at"] = now_iso
        _save("api_keys.json", keys)
        _save("tool_requests.json", reqs)
        return _err("RATE_LIMIT", "Rate limit exceeded.", request_id=req_id)

    # Transition to running (received -> running)
    req_row["status"] = "running"
    req_row["updated_at"] = now_iso
    _save("tool_requests.json", reqs)

    # Simulated upstream ADT success using local metadata/cache model:
    # Upsert abap_objects(TYPEINFO) and create TYPEINFO artifact with structured payload.
    obj = next((o for o in objs if o.get("system_id") == system_id and o.get("object_type") == "TYPEINFO" and o.get("name") == type_name), None)
    if obj is None:
        obj_id = "abap_obj_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        obj = {
            "id": obj_id,
            "system_id": system_id,
            "object_type": "TYPEINFO",
            "name": type_name,
            "package_name": None,
            "uri": "/sap/bc/adt/typeinfo/" + type_name,
            "description": None,
            "is_standard": (not (type_name.startswith("Z") or type_name.startswith("Y"))),
            "status": "known",
            "last_indexed_at": now_iso,
            "created_at": now_iso,
            "updated_at": now_iso,
        }
        objs.append(obj)
    else:
        if obj.get("status") in ("deleted",):
            # stale->known allowed, deleted has no transitions; treat as conflict with lifecycle
            req_row["status"] = "failed"
            req_row["error_code"] = "INVALID_TRANSITION"
            req_row["error_message"] = "Object is deleted and cannot be refreshed."
            req_row["completed_at"] = now_iso
            req_row["updated_at"] = now_iso
            req_row["duration_ms"] = max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000))
            api_key["last_used_at"] = now_iso
            api_key["updated_at"] = now_iso
            _save("api_keys.json", keys)
            _save("abap_objects.json", objs)
            _save("tool_requests.json", reqs)
            return _err("INVALID_TRANSITION", "Object is deleted and cannot be refreshed.", request_id=req_id, object_id=obj.get("id"))
        obj["status"] = "known"
        obj["last_indexed_at"] = now_iso
        obj["updated_at"] = now_iso

    _save("abap_objects.json", objs)

    # Supersede previous current TYPEINFO artifacts
    for a in arts:
        if a.get("object_id") == obj["id"] and a.get("artifact_kind") == "TYPEINFO" and a.get("status") == "current":
            a["status"] = "superseded"
            a["updated_at"] = now_iso

    art_id = "abap_art_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
    eff_lang = language if language is not None else sys_row.get("default_language")
    eff_alv = abap_language_version if abap_language_version is not None else sys_row.get("default_abap_language_version")
    payload = {
        "type_name": type_name,
        "language": eff_lang,
        "abap_language_version": eff_alv,
        "resolved_at": now_iso,
        "note": "Type info payload is derived from local datastore model (offline).",
    }
    art = {
        "id": art_id,
        "object_id": obj["id"],
        "artifact_kind": "TYPEINFO",
        "content_type": "application/json",
        "payload_text": None,
        "payload_json": payload,
        "etag": None,
        "retrieved_at": now_iso,
        "retrieved_by_key_id": api_key["id"],
        "status": "current",
        "created_at": now_iso,
        "updated_at": now_iso,
    }
    arts.append(art)
    _save("abap_object_artifacts.json", arts)

    # Finish request: running -> succeeded
    req_row["resolved_object_id"] = obj["id"]
    req_row["result_artifact_id"] = art_id
    req_row["http_status"] = 200
    req_row["status"] = "succeeded"
    req_row["completed_at"] = now_iso
    req_row["updated_at"] = now_iso
    req_row["duration_ms"] = max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000))

    api_key["last_used_at"] = now_iso
    api_key["updated_at"] = now_iso
    _save("api_keys.json", keys)
    _save("tool_requests.json", reqs)

    return {
        "type_name": type_name,
        "system_id": system_id,
        "language": eff_lang,
        "abap_language_version": eff_alv,
        "object": obj,
        "artifact": art,
        "request_id": req_id,
    }

tool_schemas.name: GetInclude

Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid system_id or empty include_name, UNAUTHORIZED if the caller is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to access the system or include, and NOT_FOUND if the include does not exist or cannot be resolved by ADT. tool_schemas.name: SearchObject
tool_schemas.description: Runs an ADT quick search in the specified SAP ABAP system and returns a paged list of matching repository objects (optionally filtered by object_types, package_name, is_standard, and language) sorted by the requested field and order; responses include up to limit items and, when more results exist, a cursor to request the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when system_id does not match the required pattern, query is empty, limit is outside 1–200, cursor/language/package_name are empty strings, or any enum field contains an unsupported value. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN when the caller is not allowed to access the target system or search repository objects, NOT_FOUND when system_id is not a configured/known ADT system, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request or search limits for the tenant/caller are exceeded.

system_id.description: Target ADT system id to route the request to.

query.description: Quick search query string used to find matching ABAP repository objects.

object_types.description: Optional list of ABAP object types to restrict results to.

package_name.description: Optional package name to restrict results to objects in a specific package.

is_standard.description: If provided, filters results to standard (true) or customer (false) objects.

language.description: Logon language for search (overrides the system default_language if provided).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous SearchObject response.

sort_order.description: Sort direction for the sort field.

tool_schemas.name: GetInterface
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves the ABAP interface definition/source for interface_name from the specified SAP ABAP system and returns the interface content using the requested language and ABAP language version when provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when system_id does not match the required pattern or interface_name/language/abap_language_version are empty strings. Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN when the caller is not allowed to access the target system or read the interface source, NOT_FOUND when system_id is not a configured/known ADT system or the interface does not exist in that system, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when request limits for the tenant/caller are exceeded.

system_id.description: Target ADT system id to route the request to.

interface_name.description: ABAP interface name whose source code should be retrieved.

language.description: Logon language for retrieval (overrides the system default_language if provided).

abap_language_version.description: ABAP language version to use for retrieval (overrides the system default_abap_language_version if provided).

    systems = _load("adt_systems.json")

    window_start = now - datetime.timedelta(seconds=60)

    recent = 0

    for r in reqs:

    if (rpm >= 0 and recent > rpm) or (rpd >= 0 and daily > rpd):
        req_row["status"] = "rejected"

tool_schemas.name: ListToolRequests
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted tool request audit records for the authenticated caller’s API key and system, ordered by requested_at descending. Supports filtering by status, tool_name, time range, and error_code. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not authenticated and FORBIDDEN when the API key is not active or does not permit access to audit data.

system_id.description: Filter to a specific ADT system id; must match the authenticated API key’s system_id.

status.description: Filter by tool request lifecycle status.

tool_name.description: Filter by tool name (e.g., GetClass, SearchObject).

requested_after.description: Include only requests with requested_at >= this timestamp (RFC 3339).

requested_before.description: Include only requests with requested_at <= this timestamp (RFC 3339).

page_size.description: Maximum number of records to return per page.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: GetToolRequest
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single persisted tool request audit record by id, including its resolved_object_id and result_artifact_id when available. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not authenticated, and FORBIDDEN when the record does not belong to the caller’s API key/system.

tool_schemas.name: ListAbapObjects
tool_schemas.description: Lists ABAP repository objects that have been discovered/indexed via retrieval tools for a given ADT system. Supports filtering by object_type, name prefix, package_name, and status. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not authenticated and FORBIDDEN when system_id does not match the authenticated API key’s system_id.

system_id.description: Target ADT system id whose objects to list.

name_prefix.description: Case-insensitive prefix filter for object name.

page_size.description: Maximum number of objects to return per page.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: GetAbapObject
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single ABAP object metadata record by id. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the object does not exist, UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not authenticated, and FORBIDDEN when the object’s system_id does not match the authenticated API key’s system_id.

tool_schemas.name: ListAbapObjectArtifacts
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted artifacts for an ABAP object (e.g., SOURCE, DDIC_SCHEMA, PACKAGE_DETAILS, TYPEINFO, TABLE_CONTENTS). Supports filtering by artifact_kind and status. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not authenticated and FORBIDDEN when the object belongs to a different system than the authenticated API key.

object_id.description: ABAP object id whose artifacts to list.

page_size.description: Maximum number of artifacts to return per page.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: GetCallerIdentity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity for the presented API key, including key id, key_prefix, system_id, allowed_tools, effective feature flags, and current rate-limit consumption (per-minute and per-day) computed from recent tool_requests. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED when no credentials are presented and FORBIDDEN when the API key is revoked or expired.

include_quota.description: When true, include current quota/rate-limit usage counters and reset timestamps.
